digest.component_or_area: dependency management and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, lock files, pre-commit)
propositions: GitHub PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge directly and must be re-landed as Gerrit changes because GitHub is a read-only mirror
PR #123 bumps actions/setup-python 6→7 and pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish to a new SHA across 13 workflow files and allowlist echo lines
PR #124 upgrades mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major version) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1, requiring constraint updates in pyproject.toml and uv.lock
mcp 2.0 poses a breaking-change risk: rebar-mcp imports v1 API paths (mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP, mcp.server.auth.*) that may not exist in 2.0
click 8.2.1 has a PYSEC-2026-2132 command-injection vulnerability requiring pip-audit to pass; a Change 0 must land first to unblock all other CI runs
Two out-of-pyproject.toml constraint consumers (.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:105 and ADR 0050 documentation) must be updated consistently with the mcp constraint decision
